Container.Name: adguardhome-lancache-dns
Container.Overview: Unraid Community Apps template for AdGuardHome LanCache DNS Synchronizer by sq4ind. This repository provides the Unraid installation template only; the application code and Docker image are maintained by the upstream author.
Container.Requires: An existing AdGuard Home instance reachable from this container, and a running LanCache server.

Config.Name: AdGuard API URL
Config.Description: AdGuard Home API URL, including protocol and port (required). Example: http://192.168.1.2:3000

Config.Name: LanCache Server
Config.Description: LanCache server IP or hostname that rewrites will point to (required). Example: 192.168.1.100

Config.Name: Cron Schedule
Config.Description: Cron schedule for periodic syncs. Default runs daily at midnight.

Config.Name: All Services
Config.Description: Enable all services from cache-domains. Set to false and use Service Names to pick specific ones.

Config.Name: Service Names
Config.Description: Comma-separated list of services to enable when All Services is false. Example: steam,epicgames,wsus,xboxlive

Config.Name: Max Workers
Config.Description: Number of concurrent download workers. Lower for slow networks, higher for fast ones.

Config.Name: Batch Size
Config.Description: Number of rewrites between progress log messages.

Config.Name: Cache File
Config.Description: Path inside the container for the DNS rewrite cache file. Leave empty to disable caching. If used, keep it under the Cache Directory path below so it persists.

Config.Name: Cache Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the DNS rewrite cache (only needed if Cache File is set).
